skills.name: brainstorm
skills.description: Expands the problem space and generates alternative idea directions.
skills.when_to_use: Use when a topic is ambiguous or early-stage and you need to quickly open possible directions, options, and hypotheses.
skills.argument_hint: Provide the problem or topic, context, goal, and known constraints.

skills.name: clarify
skills.description: Reduces ambiguity and makes the problem more explicit.
skills.when_to_use: Use when the request, goal, or terms are ambiguous and assumptions need to be surfaced before framing the problem.
skills.argument_hint: Provide the current request, ambiguous parts, known definitions, and open questions.

skills.name: analyze
skills.description: Examines constraints, risks, dependencies, and cause-effect relationships.
skills.when_to_use: Use when you need a systematic review of impacts, technical limits, root causes, or trade-off areas.
skills.argument_hint: Provide the topic to examine, current evidence, constraints, and the questions that must be answered.

skills.name: design
skills.description: Shapes a structural solution for the selected direction.
skills.when_to_use: Use when alternatives have been narrowed and the solution flow, component boundaries, data shape, or interaction structure must be defined.
skills.argument_hint: Provide the target architecture area, requirements, constraints, and preferred direction.

skills.name: decide
skills.description: Selects among alternatives with explicit rationale.
skills.when_to_use: Use when multiple reasonable options exist and decision criteria must be made explicit to select one direction.
skills.argument_hint: Provide the options, decision criteria, weightings, and acceptable risk level.

skills.name: reflect
skills.description: Reviews the quality and gaps of the generated outcome after the fact.
skills.when_to_use: Use when a generated plan, decision, or design needs its assumptions checked again and gaps, risks, or follow-up actions identified.
skills.argument_hint: Provide the output to review, success criteria, and any suspicious points.
